subdivisionPolicies.notes: The lower 48 state abbreviations exclude AK and HI. DC is included from the sponsor-linked UDC v1.1.4 changelog.

These are logger multiplier tokens from the sponsor FAQ image, not a political-province count or a general Canadian identity model. The table labels LB as Labrador (VO2) and NF as Newfoundland and Labrador (VO1/VO2), so LB remains distinct only under this versioned sponsor-table policy. Raw NL is retained; only its scoring key canonicalizes to NF.
